nodes.svg_description: Single-word logotype reading 'ego' rendered as a custom high-contrast Didone-style vector mark in solid black (#111111). The letters are lowercase with very thick vertical stems and narrow hairlines: the 'e' has a vertical almond-shaped counter with a horizontal crossbar that meets a heavy bowl; the 'g' features a teardrop terminal above the x-height and a bold descending swash that curves leftward into a near-circle loop, ending with a small rounded terminal; the final 'o' is an oval with a vertically oriented almond-shaped counter. All shapes are smooth, with no strokes—only filled paths.
